quote: $499 per month plus tax for 36 months. $2,999 due at signing, plus tax, title, license, registration, and applicable government fees. No security deposit required.
statute: CA Vehicle Code §11713.16; 12 CFR §1013 (Reg M); B&P Code §17500

title: Used VDPs label price as 'Sale Price' with no reference price or sale end date
recommendation: **NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW AND VERIFICATION** — Used vehicle detail pages label the asking price 'Sale Price' with no strike-through/original reference price and no visible start/end dates (same pattern on the Hyundai Sonata VDP: 'Sale Price: $18,990'). B&P §17501 attaches a temporary-reduction-from-a-genuine-prior-price meaning to 'Sale.' Because no reference price or savings figure is claimed, consumer-mislead risk is low, but a perpetual/undated 'Sale Price' label is a best-practice concern. Human should confirm whether these prices are genuinely time-limited or simply the selling price; if the latter, relabel to 'Price'/'Internet Price' or add a bona fide sale window. Cannot verify perpetuity from a single crawl.

title: Stacked-rebate pricing relies on a generic 'may not qualify' disclaimer without itemizing each rebate's qualifications
quote: Customer may not qualify for ALL Rebates shown. Some rebates are stackable and others can and cannot be combined. See Dealer For Complete Details.
recommendation: **NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW AND VERIFICATION** — The advertised selling price ($36,682) is built from MSRP minus a dealer discount minus one factory rebate ('Retail Bonus Cash: -$2,500', disclosed as '$2500 - 2026 National Retail Bonus Cash. Exp. 08/03/2026'). National Retail Bonus Cash is generally universal, so on the crawled VDP there is no evident hidden conditional stacking, and a generic stacking disclaimer plus expiration IS present. Where multiple/conditional rebates (loyalty, conquest, military, finance-contingent) are combined elsewhere on the site, the generic disclaimer does not itemize each rebate's qualification criteria. Human should confirm no offer deducts a conditional rebate a typical buyer would not qualify for. Low legal risk on the pages reviewed.

title: Lead/email capture and 'Request Lease Payment' quote forms — notice-at-collection / financial-incentive review
quote: By filling out this form with your information we will be able to provide you with our best lease payment available for this vehicle. Please know that additional rebates, incentives, and discounts may be available and will require further information from the prospective lessee.
recommendation: **NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW AND VERIFICATION** — The homepage email-capture form was crawled with has_privacy_link=false and has_notice_at_collection=false, and VDPs gate a personalized 'best lease payment'/'E-Price' behind PI submission. Note the full selling price IS shown openly on VDPs (e.g., $36,682), so core pricing is not gated — only an incremental personalized quote is, which lowers the CCPA financial-incentive risk. Human should confirm a Notice at Collection (or link to it) appears at/near each PI collection point and that any benefit-for-PI exchange is addressed in the privacy policy. Automated crawl may have missed a footer-linked notice.

title: Used-vehicle pages do not reference the CARS Act 3-day cancellation right (forward-looking, SB 766)
quote: (no 3-day cancellation-right reference found in the extracted used-inventory page content; no contradictory 'all sales final' or waiver language detected either)
recommendation: **NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW AND VERIFICATION** — This is advisory and forward-looking: the federal FTC CARS Rule is vacated and CA SB 766 does not take effect until 2026-10-01, so there is no current violation. The primary 3-day cancellation disclosure (used vehicles $50,000 or less) is delivered at point of sale, so its absence from the website is a best-practice gap, not a violation. Importantly, no contradictory 'all sales final'/waiver language was found. Recommend adding an accurate reference to the 3-day cancellation right (3 calendar days, $50K threshold, statutory restocking-fee limits, 400-mile cap) on used pages before 2026-10-01. Only the first portion of the page was captured; human should confirm no cancellation/return policy exists elsewhere on the site.
